bullets.id: Emas rebound 1,6% ke $4.180,54 (futures +0,8% ke $4.212,01) setelah crash ~4% — harga minyak yang turun meredakan tekanan dari yield Treasury yang masih di atas 5%.
bullets.en: Gold rebounded 1.6% to $4,180.54 (futures +0.8% to $4,212.01) after a ~4% crash — falling oil prices eased pressure from Treasury yields still above 5%.

bullets.id: Tapi tren jangka pendek masih bearish: harga di bawah EMA50 dan RSI intraday sudah overbought — rebound rawan kehilangan momentum. Support $4.157 lalu $4.100; resistance $4.313, dan baru close di atas $4.400 yang membatalkan pandangan turun.
bullets.en: But the short-term trend remains bearish: price sits below the EMA50 and intraday RSI is already overbought — the rebound risks losing momentum. Support at $4,157 then $4,100; resistance at $4,313, and only a close above $4,400 negates the bearish view.

bullets.id: Penentu hari ini: triple data AS — ADP September (sebelumnya 38K, terlemah sejak Januari), estimasi ketiga PDB Q2 (1,5%), dan PCE Agustus (3,7%, core 3,3%). Data panas membuka jalan ke $4.100/$4.000; data dingin membuka pantulan ke $4.313/$4.400.
bullets.en: Today's deciders: a US data triple-header — September ADP (previously 38K, weakest since January), third Q2 GDP estimate (1.5%), and August PCE (3.7%, core 3.3%). Hot data opens the path to $4,100/$4,000; cool data opens a bounce to $4,313/$4,400.

bullets.id: Antam ikut rebound: naik Rp15.000 ke Rp2.595.000/gram, buyback naik Rp30.000 ke Rp2.405.000 (spread mengecil ke Rp190.000). Bantal struktural tetap ada — bank sentral rekor 289 ton di Q2; untuk investor IDR, koreksi ini tetap window DCA, bukan momen all-in.
bullets.en: Antam rebounded too: up Rp15,000 to Rp2,595,000/gram, buyback up Rp30,000 to Rp2,405,000 (spread narrowed to Rp190,000). The structural cushion remains — central banks bought a record 289t in Q2; for IDR investors, this correction is still a DCA window, not an all-in moment.
